func_80034734_35334.title: Run the native task scheduler
func_80034734_35334.summary: Walks the native task hierarchy and executes each eligible task callback sequence.
behavior: Starts at the root task list and updates D_8016DAB4_16E6B4 as it visits tasks. A live task carries its next pointer at +0x00, an unsigned 16-bit hierarchy depth at +0x20 and unsigned 16-bit execution flags at +0x22.

The execution gate tests task flags against the unsigned 16-bit system mask at full-system +0x3AE24, limited to the low three bits: (task_flags & system_mask & 7) != 0 skips the task. A skipped task also suppresses every following descendant whose depth is greater; iteration resumes at a peer or ancestor.

For an eligible task, the scheduler restores its resource context, then invokes non-null enabled callbacks at task +0x08, +0x0C and +0x10 in order. Each callback receives the current task and its object pointer from task +0x18. Callback addresses carrying bit 0x00800000 are inhibited.

The native Start pause sequence adds mask bit 0x0001 to suspend matching gameplay task subtrees. The separate unsigned 16-bit field at full-system +0x3AE26 selects the Start menu state machine; setting it is not a generic way to pause an unrelated dialog.
This function does not stop the game loop, input sampling, rendering, VI counter or frame counter. Systems outside its task hierarchy require their own pause policy.
func_80034734_35334.exampleExplanation: The entry hook reads the established native mask while leaving task execution and ownership to the engine.
cautions: Do not recurse into this scheduler from one of its callbacks; it depends on a shared current-task global and mutable linked hierarchy.
A pause mask can suppress entire subtrees, including a desired interface task. Verify the selected task flags and ancestor relationships before changing it.
Restore only state owned by the caller. A replacement native pause or scene can change the same mask during a callback.

func_8003CFD0_3DBD0.title: Advance the scenario manager
func_8003CFD0_3DBD0.summary: Runs one native scenario-manager tick, including interpreter input and dialog status.
behavior: This is the recurring scenario-manager callback installed by its initializer. The ordinary scheduler supplies task and object arguments; this implementation saves but does not otherwise read either argument.
While the byte at 0x801C7930 is nonzero, decrement it and return. Otherwise run the shared scenario interpreter and then update scenario/dialog status.

The manager is part of the gameplay task hierarchy and can be suspended by the same execution mask as gameplay. A controlled custom interaction that suppresses the ordinary scheduler may advance its owned scenario once separately, while retaining the correct current-task/resource context.
Input collection, message-window rendering and choice-cursor drawing have their own native paths. Running this callback alone is not a complete dialog initialization or rendering API.
func_8003CFD0_3DBD0.exampleExplanation: Observe the recurring manager boundary without advancing the interpreter a second time.

parameters.name: task
parameters.description: Native scenario-manager task supplied by the scheduler; not read by this callback itself.

parameters.name: object
parameters.description: Task object argument supplied by the scheduler; not read by this callback itself.

cautions: A manual call must not duplicate a tick already performed by the native scheduler.
The interpreter uses shared globals and may invoke callbacks or task operations. Verify scenario ownership and current-task context before calling it outside ordinary scheduling.
This function does not allocate or validate message windows.
